batch_node.name: AWS Core collector schedule (samsite-owned) v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Samsite-owned schedule for the AWS Core (boto3) collector. Lives in the samsite plugin rather than aws_core because aws_core ships to consumers that shouldn't get a scheduled collection by default — a schedule belongs to the project that wants its AWS state refreshed, not to the shared collector plugin. Fires once per day at 12:00 UTC, paired with the Samsite Compliance schedule (midnight) so AWS resource state refreshes mid-day and compliance synthesis runs ~12 hours later against the fresh data. The SCHEDULED_TARGET edge points at the AWS Core collector entity (whose entity_id is the UUIDv5 derived from its registry scope:key per req-tap-cares-collector-model-10) — the target lives in aws_core, only the schedule that fires it is samsite-owned.

node.name: AWS Core collector — mid-day
node.description: Runs the AWS Core (boto3) collector once per day at 12:00 UTC to refresh the AWS resource graph (Route53 / CloudFront / S3 / Lambda / IAM / ...) for the registered AWS account(s).
